image_description: A close-up, side-profile view of a Brown Pelican standing on a rocky surface with water in the background. The bird has dark brown/grey plumage on its body and wings, with a lighter, yellowish-white head and neck. Its most prominent feature is a long, massive bill with a visible gular pouch. One leg is partially visible, appearing dark and sturdy.
